# SDK v1 capture compatibility fixture

These synthetic values were generated by the unmodified Core and SDK sources at commit `3477ba401ccf7ce71b62245de3e330d3b5724dfc`, using SDK `0.1.0-alpha.1` and process protocol 3. They cover the original text-only source bundle, source input, frozen Core input, runtime environment, source-import declaration and review binding.

The saved bytes and digests are fixed expectations for reading the supported baseline. Do not regenerate them using the current types. The native executable identity is synthetic; these fixtures neither prove an actual Host identity nor grant execution or launch a worker.

`project-v74.sql` is SQLite's full text dump of an actual schema 74 project created and reopened by the same unmodified baseline Core with its explicit in-process test host. It contains two synthetic SMAPI source entries, their captured bytes, extraction input/result, adoption receipt, and one saved manual Chinese translation. `project-v74.json` records those fixed identities. It does not contain a real Mod, credentials, or native-worker evidence. The upgrade test compares every stored record and the original-schema backup, in addition to reading the source and translation through Core.
